title: Mine
body:
Syntax: mine

Hold a valid Mining pickaxe and stand in a mountain biome. Mining's normal finds are ores only: Iron Ore (Mining 1), Steel Ore (Mining 20), Chakra Steel Ore (Mining 50). Pickaxe tier also gates each ore. Failed mining and worn pickaxes retain their existing stamina/durability rules.

Every successful mine has a separate 3% chance to award ONE rare bonus gem alongside the ore: Rough Quartz, Jade, Amber, Garnet, Amethyst, Topaz, Sapphire, Emerald, Ruby or Diamond. Rough Quartz is never a main mining find. The five elemental gems have equal bonus-drop weights. Every bonus gem can be processed with GEMCUT; see help gemcut.

Date: 2026-11-02
